subject: [PATCH 4/4] mm/mempolicy: skip zone device folios when queueing folios

2026-07-28.patch_summary: This patch modifies three functions in the Linux kernel's memory policy module to skip zone device folios when queueing them for migration. The issue it solves is that existing checks were not sufficient to prevent zone device PMDs from being added to the migration pagelist, which could lead to incorrect behavior and unnecessary failures. The approach taken is to add explicit checks in each of the three functions (queue_folios_pmd, queue_folios_pte_range, and queue_folios_hugetlb) to skip zone device folios, mirroring the existing check in one of the functions.
